cards.target: Se vocês quiserem, podemos remarcar.
cards.english: If you want, we can reschedule.

cards.target: Quem quiser participar, que se inscreva.
cards.english: Whoever wants to participate should register.

cards.target: A responsabilidade de que se trata é compartilhada.
cards.english: The responsibility in question is shared.

cards.target: Urge que se tomem providências imediatas.
cards.english: It's urgent that immediate measures be taken.

cards.target: A triangulação dos dados conferiu maior robustez à pesquisa.
cards.english: Data triangulation gave the research greater robustness.

cards.target: O que me deixou mais surpreso foi a reação dele.
cards.english: What surprised me most was his reaction.

cards.target: Faz-se necessário reavaliar os critérios adotados.
cards.english: It is necessary to reassess the criteria adopted.

cards.target: Caso haja necessidade, estaremos à disposição.
cards.english: Should there be a need, we'll be available.

cards.target: A empresa, cujo faturamento triplicou, planeja expandir.
cards.english: The company, whose revenue tripled, plans to expand.

cards.target: Enquanto eu estiver aqui, nada vai acontecer.
cards.english: As long as I'm here, nothing will happen.

cards.target: O que lhe disseram confirmara suas suspeitas.
cards.english: What they told him confirmed his suspicions.

cards.target: Se o mercado reagir bem, investimos mais.
cards.english: If the market reacts well, we'll invest more.

cards.target: Herdara do pai o gosto pela música.
cards.english: He had inherited his father's love of music.

cards.target: A questão não é se vamos, mas quando.
cards.english: The question isn't whether we're going, but when.

cards.target: Fossem outros os tempos, a situação seria diferente.
cards.english: Were times different, the situation would be different.

cards.target: Seja lá o que for, vamos resolver juntos.
cards.english: Whatever it may be, we'll solve it together.

cards.target: A situação em que nos metemos exige cautela.
cards.english: The situation we've gotten ourselves into requires caution.

cards.target: Ao que tudo indica, o projeto será aprovado.
cards.english: By all indications, the project will be approved.

cards.target: Trata-se de uma situação que exige análise cuidadosa.
cards.english: This is a situation that requires careful analysis.

cards.target: Se eu der sorte, consigo o último ingresso.
cards.english: If I'm lucky, I'll get the last ticket.

cards.target: Outrem não haveria de compreender o que vivemos.
cards.english: Anyone else would understand what we experienced.

cards.target: A bem da verdade, ninguém esperava esse desfecho.
cards.english: Truth be told, no one expected this outcome.

cards.target: Haveremos de encontrar uma solução, cedo ou tarde.
cards.english: We shall find a solution, sooner or later.

cards.target: Aquilo de que eu tinha medo acabou se concretizando.
cards.english: What I was afraid of ended up happening.

cards.target: Está mais do que provado que esse método funciona.
cards.english: It's more than proven that this method works.

cards.target: Mercê das novas tecnologias, a comunicação se tornou instantânea.
cards.english: Thanks to new technologies, communication has become instantaneous.

cards.target: A maneira como ele lidou com a crise foi exemplar.
cards.english: The way he handled the crisis was exemplary.

cards.target: A despeito do que muitos pensam, o resultado foi satisfatório.
cards.english: Despite what many think, the result was satisfactory.

cards.target: Fora ele quem trouxera a notícia.
cards.english: It was he who had brought the news.

cards.target: Enquanto eu viver, lutarei por justiça.
cards.english: As long as I live, I'll fight for justice.

cards.target: Importa ressaltar que os dados são preliminares.
cards.english: It's important to emphasize that the data is preliminary.

cards.target: Importa salientar que as conclusões são provisórias.
cards.english: It's important to highlight that the conclusions are provisional.

cards.target: O resultado, qualquer que seja, será respeitado.
cards.english: The result, whatever it may be, will be respected.

cards.target: Se eu puder ajudar, será um prazer.
cards.english: If I can help, it will be a pleasure.

cards.target: Por incrível que pareça, ele chegou no horário.
cards.english: Incredible as it may seem, he arrived on time.

cards.target: Quando eu me aposentar, quero viajar pelo Brasil.
cards.english: When I retire, I want to travel around Brazil.

cards.target: Se nós tivermos os recursos, podemos começar amanhã.
cards.english: If we have the resources, we can start tomorrow.

cards.target: Dera o melhor de si, e isso bastava.
cards.english: He had given his best, and that was enough.

cards.target: O projeto, ao qual foram destinados milhões, está parado.
cards.english: The project, to which millions were allocated, is stalled.

cards.target: Considerando-se que os recursos são limitados, priorizemos o essencial.
cards.english: Considering that resources are limited, let's prioritize the essential.

cards.target: A carta que ela escrevera permaneceu guardada por décadas.
cards.english: The letter she had written remained stored for decades.

cards.target: Cabe ao governo tomar as medidas necessárias.
cards.english: It's up to the government to take the necessary measures.

cards.target: Afigura-se improvável que ele consiga cumprir o prazo.
cards.english: It seems unlikely that he'll manage to meet the deadline.

cards.target: A hipótese de que se partiu mostrou-se equivocada.
cards.english: The hypothesis they began with proved to be wrong.

cards.target: Consta que ele apresentará a renúncia na segunda-feira.
cards.english: It's reported that he will submit his resignation on Monday.

cards.target: Independentemente de quem vença, o importante é participar.
cards.english: Regardless of who wins, the important thing is to participate.

cards.target: Ele fizera tudo o que lhe fora pedido.
cards.english: He had done everything that had been asked of him.

cards.target: Se eles fizerem a proposta, avaliamos na hora.
cards.english: If they make the proposal, we'll evaluate it right away.

cards.target: Fosse ele um pouco mais humilde, seria mais admirado.
cards.english: Were he a bit more humble, he'd be more admired.

cards.target: Quer ele concorde, quer discorde, a decisão está tomada.
cards.english: Whether he agrees or disagrees, the decision has been made.

cards.target: À luz dos fatos apresentados, a decisão parece acertada.
cards.english: In light of the facts presented, the decision seems correct.

cards.target: Aquele que vencera tantas batalhas finalmente conheceu a derrota.
cards.english: He who had won so many battles finally met defeat.

cards.target: Dado o contexto em que nos encontramos, prudência é fundamental.
cards.english: Given the context we find ourselves in, prudence is essential.

cards.target: O problema é menos o custo e mais a logística.
cards.english: The problem is less the cost and more the logistics.

cards.target: A questão à qual me refiro é de ordem ética.
cards.english: The issue I'm referring to is of an ethical nature.

cards.target: Mesmo que todas as condições fossem favoráveis, eu ainda hesitaria.
cards.english: Even if all conditions were favorable, I would still hesitate.

cards.target: O modo pelo qual a pesquisa foi conduzida levanta dúvidas.
cards.english: The manner in which the research was conducted raises doubts.

cards.target: A circunstância de os dados serem incompletos compromete a análise.
cards.english: The fact that the data is incomplete compromises the analysis.

cards.target: As lágrimas que derramara naquela noite secaram com o tempo.
cards.english: The tears he had shed that night dried with time.

cards.target: Resta saber se as promessas serão cumpridas.
cards.english: It remains to be seen whether the promises will be kept.

existing_tips: 'Quanto mais...mais' is the Portuguese equivalent of 'the more...the more' – a correlative structure
